September 16, 2026 — Kīlauea Summit Eruption Reference Map

Quick summary

The USGS Hawaiian Volcano Observatory published a reference map of the Kīlauea summit eruption on September 16, 2026, based on helicopter overflight data collected during the eruption's early hours.

Key takeaways

  • The USGS Hawaiian Volcano Observatory released a reference map for the September 16, 2026 Kīlauea summit eruption
  • Most data for the map were collected during a USGS Hawaiian Volcano Observatory helicopter overflight on the morning of September 16
  • The map documents new volcanic activity at the Halemaʻumaʻu crater within the Kīlauea summit caldera
  • The reference map is part of the observatory's ongoing Photo & Video Chronology series tracking eruptive activity at Kīlauea
  • Five new eruptive features were documented during the overflight survey
